from copy import deepcopy

from demo_app import ranking


def test_generated_popularity_ranks_likes_before_recency():
    posts = [
        {"id": 1, "likes": 8, "created_at": "2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00"},
        {"id": 2, "likes": 1, "created_at": "2026-01-02T12:00:00+00:00"},
    ]
    original = deepcopy(posts)
    assert ranking.ORDERING == "popular"
    assert [post["id"] for post in ranking.rank(posts)] == [1, 2]
    assert posts == original
